name: io.github.ayushcodes10/echo-mem
title: Echo Memory
description: Shared memory for AI agents, as a graph in your own Postgres. Writes never call an LLM.

environmentVariables.name: ECHO_MEMORY_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection string. `echo-memory quickstart` starts a suitable database and prints this.

environmentVariables.name: ECHO_MEMORY_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Whose memory this is. Scopes every read and write.

environmentVariables.name: ECHO_MEMORY_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Which tool is writing: claude-code, cursor, codex, claude-desktop. Recorded on every fact, and what makes a cross-tool recall visible afterwards.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <key>, from https://app.echo-mem.com — the hosted option, which needs no local database.
